name: museum-info-system-qa
description: QA automation scaffold for Museum Info System

scripts.qa:server:flask: FLASK_ENV=testing SECRET_KEY=test-secret REDIS_URL='' SESSION_TYPE=filesystem SESSION_FILE_DIR=logs/qa_flask_session RATELIMIT_STORAGE_URL=memory:// SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=False python app.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5050
scripts.qa:server:gunicorn: FLASK_ENV=testing SECRET_KEY=test-secret REDIS_URL='' SESSION_TYPE=filesystem SESSION_FILE_DIR=logs/qa_flask_session RATELIMIT_STORAGE_URL=memory:// SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=False WORKERS=4 GUNICORN_RUN_USER=$(id -un) GUNICORN_RUN_GROUP=$(id -gn) gunicorn -c gunicorn.conf.py --pid /tmp/museum_info_system_qa.pid --bind 127.0.0.1:5051 app:app
scripts.qa:python: SECRET_KEY=test-secret REDIS_URL='' FLASK_ENV=testing SESSION_TYPE=filesystem SESSION_FILE_DIR=logs/qa_flask_session RATELIMIT_STORAGE_URL=memory:// python3 -m pytest -q test_qa_smoke_flows.py test_error_handling_flows.py test_authorization_regressions.py test_edge_case_flows.py test_website_news_cache_guard.py test_observability_bootstrap.py test_sentry_helpers.py
scripts.qa:lint: eslint cypress playwright load cypress.config.js playwright.config.js
scripts.qa:observability: SECRET_KEY=test-secret REDIS_URL='' FLASK_ENV=testing SESSION_TYPE=filesystem SESSION_FILE_DIR=logs/qa_flask_session RATELIMIT_STORAGE_URL=memory:// python3 scripts/testing/check_observability.py
scripts.qa:browser: npm run e2e:all && npm run e2e:playwright
scripts.qa:all: npm run qa:lint && npm run qa:python && npm run qa:browser
